ody.text: Otaria is where the Mirari appears a century after the Phyrexian Invasion, starting wars that devastate the continent.
Chainer finds the Mirari in an old mansion, and it passes to Kirtar, who is corrupted and uses it to kill Pianna, before his uncontrolled spell wrecks the Order's citadel and kills him.
Emperor Aboshan then pours mana into it, flooding the northern third of Otaria and destroying the capital.
Kamahl attaches the Mirari to his sword and tries to unite the Pardic barbarians by force, mortally wounding his sister Jeska, whom the Cabal Patriarch's attempt to destroy her turns into Phage.

tor.text: In Torment, Chainer discovers the Mirari and rises through the Cabal, rivaling the Patriarch before his fall.
The Mirari pulses in the Cabal's vault and spreads darkness over Otaria, and Chainer's insanity touches nearly every living thing.
Teroh vows to be the holy wind that avenges the Cabal's victims.

jud.text: Kamahl keeps the Mirari away from others and from himself, honoring his promise to a dying Chainer, while Laquatus and Eesha try to obtain it.
Back home, the Mirari dominates Kamahl, who tries to take all the tribes under his dictatorship, and he impales Jeska with the Mirari-sword before resolving to be rid of it.
The Mirari pours energy into Krosa, mutating creatures and plants across Otaria, until Karn reveals its origins and takes it back to Argentum.

ons.text: Ixidor discovers his reality-sculpting powers and uses them to create the angel Akroma, who vows to stay her hand only when Phage is destroyed.
Phage, once Jeska, drains her victims' energy, though a faint memory of Jeska stirs before she is lost again.
Meanwhile Order clerics contain as much of the Mirari's energy as possible, hoping to delay Otaria's demise.

lgn.text: Slivers break free of the Riptide Project and adapt quickly to life on Otaria, and within weeks more of them nest there than ever existed on Rath.
Kamahl and the Cabal, in an uneasy alliance, set out to defeat Akroma, who asks her troops for unwavering loyalty.
In the final battle between Phage and Akroma, the two and Zagorka merge to form Karona.

scg.text: Kamahl's Soul Reaper slays Akroma, Phage and Zagorka at the apex of their battle, and Karona is born from their fused bodies, leaving Otaria torn by militant factions.
Karona decides she must be a goddess, and the armies stop fighting to worship her.
She builds an army to destroy those who oppose her, until Kamahl frees his sister Jeska from Karona and Phage.

tsb.text: Otaria is shown as a land where slivers would survive at the expense of all other creatures.
